[↑↓] move between items
[enter] read the body in the pane
[pgup/pgdn] page the body while reading it
[tab] the backlog, the sprint, or what shipped
[/] filter by slug or title
[esc] clear the filter; again to close it
[backspace] delete a character from the filter
[s] cycle the status filter
[p] cycle the priority filter
[k] cycle the kind or size filter
[r] only what can be started now
[w] jump to what this one waits on
[e] open the file in your editor
[R] work it through to a commit
[b] mark it blocked, after confirming it
[o] reopen it, from the archive as well
[a] archive it, after confirming it
[d] delete the file, after confirming it
[n] start a new item
[S] add it to the cockpit sprint, or drop it
[esc] back to the prompt
letters  priority H high · M medium · L low — size S M L
- unset

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
[?] hide the keys
